All combat renderers (drone/stinger/flyer/mine/warden/boss/enemyBullet/powerup/shieldRing/vortexFx/shockwave + particle Points) pre-pool hidden meshes at boot -> no material appears at runtime after loadAll settles -> a boot-time compile can cover everything that exists in the scene.

=> 12v/20t, 2 => 42v/80t); flat-shaded (normal-bearing) mesh => exporter unshares
verts (a 42v sphere exports as 240v) -> use_smooth=True before export (NORMAL is
render-inert under the shared flatShading:true material; three.js recomputes); 5.2
primitives auto-generate UVs (calc_uvs) -> strip uv_layers + export_texcoords=False;
export_materials enum has no 'SKIP' (use 'NONE'/'EXPORT').

## I512 - fleet-coherence gate (ST-478, E68)

- Story: ST-478 (E68) - the last gate story before ST-479 (G68.0 close): prove, WITH MEASUREMENT, that the I511 remastered fleet holds as a coherent unit in one frame, survives as 96px silhouettes and at low DPR, and keeps its telegraph poses under reduced-motion.

- Method: .evidence/I512/coherence512.mjs - headless SwiftShader 1280x720 in-game audit, fx=high (up-to-6 f presses), rAF freeze, double-bloom render2, readPixels via offscreen drawImage+getImageData; bg/fg diff mask (pass iff NOT (dL<6 AND (dR+dG+dB)<30), dL=0.2126dR+0.7152dG+0.0722dB.
- Geometry (the rework that made A valid): the original world-space grid (x +/-16, +/-20, +/-24; z -5/-12/-19; cam [0,2.2,18] -> [0,6,-12]) projected to 8-22 px center spacing (probe-measured) so neighbor caps collapsed mask windows to 1-11 px (n=0/garbage). Final: 3x3 grid in SCREEN space - camera CAM_A [0,10,30] -> TGT_A [0,10,-10] (LEVEL, horizon at v-center 360px, pure-sky backdrop), slots unprojected from screen (x 280/640/1000, y 90/210/330) at row depths 14/28/46 into world homes; projected centers re-probed 120-360 px apart. Mask window half = max(20, 1.3*bb.r) capped by floor(minN/2)-6.
- Run history: run1 (initial harness) invalid - all9 had all-9 visible in both bg and fg (n=0); solo same. Fix: setAllVisible(false) -> bg render -> show set -> fg render; per-role hide/show for solo. Run2 exposed two more bugs: the boss fake object lacked radius -> ring scale NaN (JSON null) in C and D (bossMesh.sync reads boss.radius from the argument object - added radius: 3.4 to both fakes); the E PNG filter (v.length>2000) dropped 16/24 valid 96px sils (1100-2500 chars) - fixed to a data-URL sniff with >600. Run3 = FINAL VALID (all sections measured).
- Section A (FINAL): p50 ladder all9/solo (crossTalk, hue): drone 181.23/181.23 (+0.00, 189.5) / stinger 87.82/88.82 (-1.00, 222.6) / flyer 46.73/46.73 (+0.00, 329.4) / hunter 63.08/63.08 (+0.00, 13.5) / sentry 113.02/113.02 (+0.00, 40.7) / wasp 86.29/86.29 (+0.00, 47.3) / gunship 63.73/63.73 (+0.00, 160.3) / warden 129.13/129.13 (+0.00, 181.4) / boss 65.54/64.61 (+0.93, 257.4). E57 rule-1 AND test (|dluma|<=10 AND dhue<=40): ZERO collisions on all 8 adjacent frozen pairs in BOTH frames (andTestPass true both).

## I563 - ST-529: wave pacing fix - waves clear the moment their killables are gone, even with the ST-138 belt rocks on screen (2-line core change + 3 unit tests + 1 mock update) - tests 1,237/1,237, vendor 4/4, dist 6,430,172 B / 203, SMOKE563 PASS 6/6, CLOSEGATE563 5/5 EXACT no re-pin, quality bar 6/6

- Pre-state: local main == origin/main 4599af0 (I562, pushed - I562 push confirmed via git fetch); dist 6,430,089 B / 203; tests 1,234/1,234; vendor 4/4 EXACT.
- User report: after the blue unbreakable rocks appear (~wave 8/9), wave clearance takes a long time "even after all the asteroids and the enemies are dealt with" - feels like waiting forever; shorten it, and if the long transition had intent, fill the gap.
- Root cause: NOT a designed breather - an accidental interaction. The I42 45 s stall backstop became the de-facto flat wave duration once ST-138 made belt rocks persistent (indestructible, never split, bomb-proof, exempt from maxConcurrent, persist for the rest of the run, fromWave 8, max 5, size M, rim-spawn; spawnBeltForWave has no mode gate, called on every startedWave). From wave 8, field.count never reaches 0 -> every wave ends ONLY via the 45 s stall even when all killables die in seconds.
- Fix (2-line core + 3 tests): src/core/asteroids.js adds a killableCount getter (rocks where !r.belt, 3-line JSDoc); src/core/waves.js clear check field.count === 0 -> field.killableCount === 0 (I563 comments: belt persists by design; I42 stallTime stays only as the safety backstop); tests/waves.test.js +3 tests (seeds 5631/5632/5633): killableCount excludes the belt layer; wave clears in ONE tick once killables die (belt persists, ev.waveCleared set, stallAdvance 0); belt-only field clears and both belt rocks persist.
- Deliberately NOT changed (registered): the trickle-spawn loop check (field.count < concurrentLimit) still counts belt rocks against the 24-slot concurrency cap from wave 8 (softens density slightly) - changing it remaps spawn-RNG timing = daily salt churn.
- Determinism: zero new RNG draws on the clear path (killableCount is a pure count; tests kill via dead+compact, no RNG) -> daily salt unchanged; only wave-timing shifts earlier.
- Campaign note: the campaign wave counter persists across levels (game.js: no per-level wave reset; checkpoint continue sets intermission at waves.wave+1) -> belt rocks ALSO appear in campaign once its wave number reaches 8, with the same 45 s stall; the fix improves the campaign identically (same pacing fix, registered - NOT a regression).
- RED-test resolution: first npm test after the patch = RED (1 failure, actual 0 expected 24 = CONFIG.wave.maxConcurrentCap) at tests/endless.test.js:50 "intermission shrinks to floor, base before wave 10 (seed 68)" - its live wave-24 step drives the director against the clearedDir mock field {count: 0, spawn} that pre-dates the I563 field contract; the new clear check reads field.killableCount (undefined on the mock -> undefined === 0 false) so the wave never cleared (ev.waveCleared 0 !== 24). It documented the PRE-I563 field contract, not a bug in the patch -> mock updated to expose killableCount: 0 (I563 comment, house re-pin style).
